name: Uniform Scaling of SDFs
aliases: Uniform Scaling of Signed Distance Functions
definition: A technique to scale an SDF uniformly by dividing the sample point by the scaling factor and multiplying the returned distance by the same factor. This compensates for the distortion of distances caused by non-rigid scaling, ensuring the ray marching algorithm does not overestimate distance.
summary: Uniform scaling of SDFs transforms an implicit surface by a uniform factor while preserving distance correctness, allowing exact compensation unlike non-uniform scaling.
